PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.en: It's so good to see her here and colorful. Like she should be!

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.original_cz: Je příbuzný pana McDucka?

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.en: Why does he always wear that little hat?

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.original_cz: Proč pořád nosí ten malý klobouk?

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.en: Why is he always so angry?

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.original_cz: Proč je pořád tak naštvaný?

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.original_cz: Je! Pan McDuck je Donaldův strýc.

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.en: Donald gets angry when he's embarrassed or scared.

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.en: Sometimes it's on account of something that happened to him.

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.original_cz: Někdy je to kvůli něčemu, co se mu stalo.

PeterPan_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Discu.en: But sometimes he sort of does it to himself?
